items.html: It follows that above, in the first phase, which was called after the Mochin themselves, it is called the Mem of Tzelem, named after the Mochin themselves, and therefore the Mem of Tzelem hints at the four Yudin of HaVaYaH filled with Yudin, as mentioned above. But in this second phase, which is called the Lamed of Tzelem, named after the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of Tevuna itself — and behold, Tevuna is only the name SAG, as mentioned above — therefore even Ehyeh itself is hidden from it, and nothing remains from it except the filling of Alfin, which in gematria is Tzadi-Lamed.
